content.title: What Is Cholesterol?
content.text: A note from Cleveland ClinicCholesterol is a substance your body needs to work properly. But too much cholesterol in your blood can be dangerous for you. This is why your healthcare provider will want to check your cholesterol levels every so often. There’s usually no way to know your cholesterol levels simply by how you feel.
